Under the locked UKMR resolution, this is an official-source presentation inconsistency, not policy-rule ambiguity: use advanced through GBP 125140 inclusive and top above GBP 125140 exclusive, continuous with the preceding band and corroborated by current operational sources. Personal Allowance, taper and zero point remain separate reference rules sourced to HMRC SRC-011.
